text:
maria_ae: Hey team — Acme (CISO = @acme_ciso) needs SOC2 report, ISO excerpt, signed pen-test letter, and a short runbook for the POC. They want the staging IP allowlist and the evidence dropbox by EOD Friday. Also asked: can we freeze dedicated pricing while they complete an internal audit?

josh_se: Thanks, Maria. For the staging IPs I can post a minimal allowlist. Do we need a static CIDR or per-host IPs?

karim_security: We can provide a small /29 for the POC if infra approves. Otherwise we provide a list of ephemeral host IPs. Which does Acme prefer?

acme_ciso: Prefers static /29 during the two-week window. Also needs pen-test letter on company letterhead confirming: scope, test window, and contact for remediation. Is that possible?

maria_ae: They asked for a signed letter (PDF) acknowledging scope limited to staging only. Tara, can compliance/Legal sign the pen-test attestation template?

tara_compliance: We have a pen-test letter template but legal needs to sign off. I can get a turnaround in 48 hours if we use the standard template. If they require additional wording it may take longer.

josh_se: For the runbook, I'll attach a one-page 'POC network & credentials' doc. Example allowlist block below — pls confirm:

```
# Staging allowlist (example)
203.0.113.8/29  # POC static block
198.51.100.12   # admin jump host
```

karim_security: That /29 is fine. We just need to whitelist 203.0.113.8-203.0.113.15 on our firewall and add the CIDR to monitoring. I'll send the exact ingress rules to eng-infra.

maria_ae: Acme also asked whether the SOC2 report we provide can include control descriptions for data retention and key management (they want to verify KMS usage). Is that included or do we need an addendum?

tara_compliance: Our SOC2 report includes control narratives for encryption and access control. For KMS specifics we can provide a short addendum (1 page) describing key custody and KMS integration. I can draft that today.

acme_ciso: Great. On pricing hold — they want to avoid being charged for dedicated capacity during the audit gap. Can sales pause billing for Dedicated POC?

maria_ae: I put a hold request to pricing but need confirm process. Josh — will pausing dedicated capacity require infra changes or can we set a credit?

josh_se: Technically we can place a temporary credit or move them to burst mode with lower commit. Need approval from revenue ops. If legal needs the pause in writing, we should capture terms (start/end, SLA impact).

tara_compliance: Note: if we pause dedicated, SLA/uptime guarantees change. We should include that in the pen-test letter addendum so Acme knows the operational tradeoffs.

evidence_bot: Uploaded: /evidence/acme/1777777770/SOC2-2024-redacted.pdf (presigned link expires in 72h) :white_check_mark:

maria_ae: Thanks @evidence_bot. Karim/Tara — action items: 1) Kara (Legal) to sign pen-test template (48h) 2) Tara to draft KMS addendum (EOD) 3) Karim to confirm firewall rule exact text and send to eng-infra. I'll tell Acme we expect to deliver the bundle by Friday EOD.

karim_security: Will send firewall rules and monitoring playbook by +6h.

tara_compliance: Drafting addendum now, will post for review in #legal-review.

josh_se: I'll open a revenue-ops ticket to discuss temporary credit vs burst mode and tag @revops.

acme_ciso: Appreciated. If you can get the signed pen-test letter and staging CIDR by Friday, we can lock the POC start for next Monday.

maria_ae: Perfect — I'll update Acme and flag any blockers. :thumbsup:
